evidence: Adds an end-to-end functional test exercising wallet PSBT workflows for MuSig2 and Miniscript decaying multisig descriptors.
rationale: Adds end-to-end integration test coverage and an example descriptor for MuSig2 aggregate key path and Miniscript decaying multisig PSBT workflows across signers. This provides real verification value for complex wallet descriptor setups, but is reasonably deferrable as it introduces no wallet logic changes or bug fixes.
